hits.about: Binghatti Point is a modern 10-storey residential development located in Dubai's historic Dubai Silicon Oasis neighborhood. The project offers upscale 1-2 bedroom apartments with magnificent views of the city and ocean.The Binghatti Point building is characterized by its contemporary design and innovative architecture. The interiors have the highest quality finishes. Residents here can enjoy a high level of comfort and quality services.The Binghatti Point complex also provides extensive infrastructure facilities to the residents including a state-of-the-art fitness center, swimming pool, recreational areas, playgrounds and parking spaces. In addition, the building has a 24-hour security service to provide residents with the highest level of safety and security.Located in a popular area of Dubai, Binghatti Point enjoys a convenient location with excellent infrastructure and proximity to key city facilities such as shopping malls, restaurants, schools and office buildings. Downtown Dubai and DIFC are just 10 minutes away, Dubai International Airport can be reached in 15 minutes and Palm Jumeirah, Dubai Marina and the world's largest airport, Al Maktoum International Airport are no more than 30 minutes away by car.Binghatti Point is a quality property that offers residents comfortable living in modern and stylish surroundings with beautiful views of the surrounding landscape. The complex is ideal for couples with children, and investors can receive a stable high income from renting out the apartments.
